origin.description: Test whether e1 collates before or with e2, using the default collator.

arguments.name: e1, e2
arguments.text: Character vectors, or objects coerced with as.character. NA stays missing. The string "NA" is text.

origin.details: Test whether e1 collates before or with e2, using the default collator. One leading U+FEFF is removed before compare, sort, order, rank, unique, and duplicated, and the strings those functions return are stripped. stri_sort_key keeps that character and drops only the terminating NUL of the ICU key.
origin.value: The vector stringi returns for this function. JSON null in the captured check is NA.

translation.description: Test whether e1 collates before or with e2, using the default collator.

arguments.name: e1, e2
arguments.text: A string, NA, a number, or a list of those. None is an empty vector. None inside a list is NA.

translation.details: Test whether e1 collates before or with e2, using the default collator. One leading U+FEFF is removed before compare, sort, order, rank, unique, and duplicated, and the strings those functions return are stripped. stri_sort_key keeps that character and drops only the terminating NUL of the ICU key. Collation uses PyICU.
translation.value: A list. A bare string is a length-one list. NA is stringi._na.NA.
